assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: illustrated story sequence for PetMaestro, children's landscape game. One very wide 3:1 image containing EXACTLY THREE SQUARE PANELS edge-to-edge in one horizontal row, equal widths, straight vertical boundaries at one-third and two-thirds, no gaps, no frame or text. Each panel is an independent full illustration of the same story with consistent character designs. Panel 1: a gentle gray donkey discovers a small wooden flute on the grass beside a sunny farm path. Panel 2: the same donkey blows into the flute, a few golden musical notes float up. Panel 3: donkey smiles in surprise beside the flute in the same meadow. Style: polished colorful storybook illustration, softly shaded rounded cute animals, golden warm light, turquoise and leaf green accents, rich friendly colors matching a golden wooden cat-care game. Young children ages 4-8. Compose all important subjects safely within the central 80 percent of each square panel. No letters, words, numbers, watermarks or captions. No violence or frightening expressions. Opaque scenery fills all three panels.
